column62: Nominal age 1796 Ma; bracket 1758-1833 Ma. Park et al. (1973) sampled the Kazan Formation, Christopher Island Formation and Martell Syenite of the Baker Lake Group. Rainbird et al. (2006) date a basal Christopher Island felsic minette flow at 1833 +/- 3 Ma (U-Pb zircon) and a syenite plug that cross-cuts the sampled Kazan and Christopher Island Formations at 1811 +/- 12 Ma (Ar-Ar phlogopite, a minimum age for the sampled units). Rainbird & Davis (2007) date Pitz Formation rhyolite of the overlying Wharton Group at 1757.6 +/- 3.4 Ma. The conservative 1758-1833 Ma bracket spans these U-Pb dates; the cross-cutting 1811 Ma syenite indicates the pole most likely lies in the older half. Park et al.'s original K-Ar (~1716 Ma) and Rb-Sr (1725 +/- 4 Ma) ages used old decay constants and are superseded.
